title: Earned Wage Access Retention Terms on Early Termination — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
On a Paystride Payroll Card Program, the prorated early termination fee is multiplied when the employer keeps a Paystride Earned Wage Access program whose agreement is live today: when that agreement went live at least 6 whole months before today — by 0.5; when it went live fewer than 6 whole months before today — by 0.8; with no live agreement — the fee is not multiplied under this term.

**Records read.** The employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement: whether its status is live today and its go-live date. Whole months are the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the go-live date's.

| Agreement status today | Whole months since go-live | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| live | 6 or more | 0.5 |
| live | fewer than 6 | 0.8 |
| any status other than live, or no agreement | any | none |

### Boundary (hypothetical, today being 15 August)

- Go-live on 15 February: 6 whole months, multiplier 0.5.
- Go-live on 16 February: 5 whole months, multiplier 0.8.

A prorated fee of 412.80 multiplied by 0.5 is 206.40, and by 0.8 is 330.24.
